name: Dialog
description: Blocks the page with one focused task the user finishes or dismisses.
propsSummary: Dialog.Content initialFocus?: boolean|ref|function - focus target on open (default: true)
Dialog.Content finalFocus?: boolean|ref|function - focus target on close (default: true)
Dialog.Content width: sm|md|lg - sheet width (default: md)
Dialog.Trigger, Dialog.Close render: element - render a library control

onOpenChange.description: Called when the open state changes

when: Collecting input the user must finish in one pass
Content that needs acknowledgment before continuing
Isolating a step in a longer workflow
whenNot: A decision the user must answer, such as a destructive confirmation (use AlertDialog)
Contextual content that should not block (use Popover)
Feedback the user does not act on (use Toast or Alert)
guidelines: Title states the task; body states the consequence
Pair the primary action with an explicit cancel
Escape and an outside press dismiss; for a destructive choice use AlertDialog
Pass render={<Button />} to Dialog.Trigger — the bare trigger ships unstyled
accessibility: Focus returns to the trigger on close
role="dialog" with title and description wired to aria attributes

dont.reason: Do not use a Dialog for a non-blocking notification.
dont.good:
<Alert tone="info">
            <Alert.Icon />
            <Alert.Body>
              <Alert.Title>Settings sync pending</Alert.Title>
              <Alert.Content>Changes reach every workspace within a minute.</Alert.Content>
            </Alert.Body>
          </Alert>

dont.reason: Do not omit an accessible title and explicit close action from a Dialog.

examples.name: Default
examples.description: Header, body, and footer in the standard layout.
examples.code:
<Dialog>
          <Dialog.Trigger render={<Button>Open dialog</Button>} />
          <Dialog.Content>
            <Dialog.Close />
            <Dialog.Header>
              <Dialog.Title>Dialog title</Dialog.Title>
              <Dialog.Description>Focused supporting content.</Dialog.Description>
            </Dialog.Header>
            <Dialog.Body>Dialog body</Dialog.Body>
            <Dialog.Footer>
              <Dialog.Close render={<Button variant="ghost">Close</Button>} />
            </Dialog.Footer>
          </Dialog.Content>
        </Dialog>

examples.name: Large
examples.code:
<Dialog>
          <Dialog.Trigger render={<Button>Open large dialog</Button>} />
          <Dialog.Content width="lg">
            <Dialog.Close />
            <Dialog.Header>
              <Dialog.Title>Detailed settings</Dialog.Title>
            </Dialog.Header>
            <Dialog.Body>Complex content</Dialog.Body>
            <Dialog.Footer>
              <Dialog.Close render={<Button variant="ghost">Close</Button>} />
            </Dialog.Footer>
          </Dialog.Content>
        </Dialog>

examples.name: No Initial Focus
examples.description: Skips autofocus when you place focus yourself.
examples.code:
<Dialog>
          <Dialog.Trigger render={<Button variant="soft">Open settings</Button>} />
          <Dialog.Content initialFocus={false}>
            <Dialog.Header>
              <Dialog.Title>Settings</Dialog.Title>
              <Dialog.Description>Choose a settings area to edit.</Dialog.Description>
            </Dialog.Header>
            <Dialog.Body>Settings content</Dialog.Body>
            <Dialog.Footer>
              <Dialog.Close render={<Button variant="ghost">Close</Button>} />
            </Dialog.Footer>
          </Dialog.Content>
        </Dialog>

examples.name: Long Title
examples.description: A wrapping title keeps the close control reachable.
examples.code:
<Dialog>
          <Dialog.Trigger render={<Button>Open long title dialog</Button>} />
          <Dialog.Content>
            <Dialog.Close />
            <Dialog.Header>
              <Dialog.Title>
                Confirm the localized account recovery policy for every workspace administrator
              </Dialog.Title>
              <Dialog.Description>
                The title wraps while the close affordance and recovery action remain reachable.
              </Dialog.Description>
            </Dialog.Header>
            <Dialog.Footer>
              <Dialog.Close render={<Button variant="ghost">Close</Button>} />
            </Dialog.Footer>
          </Dialog.Content>
        </Dialog>

relations.note: Use Popover for non-modal contextual content
Use AlertDialog for a decision the user must answer
